## What is BBLS?

BBLS is a boutique website design studio serving businesses in Orange County, California. We combine clear website strategy, premium visual direction, and launch ready execution to create websites that look distinctive and work with purpose.

## Does BBLS provide website design in Orange County?

Yes. BBLS provides premium website design services for businesses throughout Orange County, including Irvine, Newport Beach, Costa Mesa, Laguna Beach, and Tustin. The studio does not claim a public street office in those cities.

## What website services does BBLS offer?

BBLS offers Simple Landing Pages, Business Websites, Commercial Websites, and optional Brand Identity services.

- Simple Landing Page. Starting at $3,000. One focused page designed to present your offer clearly and guide visitors toward the next action.
- Business Website. Starting at $5,500. A complete professional website designed to establish credibility, explain your services, and generate qualified inquiries.
- Commercial Website. Starting at $8,500. A larger, strategically structured website for businesses that need stronger content architecture, customer journeys, and conversion focused functionality.
- Brand Identity add on. Starting at $3,500. Optional. When the website needs a stronger visual foundation, BBLS can create a focused identity system covering logo, color, typography, and visual direction.

## How much does a BBLS website cost?

BBLS landing pages start at $3,000, business websites start at $5,500, and commercial websites start at $8,500. Final pricing depends on project scope and functionality.
